  - asserts every emitted leaf of each declared shape resolves (generalized over the shape, not a hand list).
  The four seeds must fail on origin/main before the change.
(4) A thaw note (pack bytes change: record-relationships.json, perhaps field-provenance). Update any relationship-count pins only where they legitimately change, and justify each in the thaw note.
